rv.q: The production creates its own dark magic with large-scale grandeur.

cn.t: Jamie Lloyd's stark production starring Sigourney Weaver in her West End debut receives mostly negative reviews. Critics praise striking visuals but find Weaver's Prospero flat and uninvolving, with the austere concept failing to bring coherence or heart to Shakespeare's play.

vr.q: Pressed to summarize this regrettably I would tell you that it is fatally dull.
